acceptance_criteria.criterion: FfprobeRunner.ResolveBinaryPath() is `internal` and its branch order is: library override → provisioner → `"ffprobe"` fallback.
ProbeAsync_UsesLibraryOverridePath_WhenBothPathsAreSet passes, confirming the library path wins over the provisioner path.
All three new pure-unit resolution tests pass without requiring a real ffprobe binary.
constraints.md no longer lists the priority inversion as an open item; the replacement note confirms parity with FfmpegRunner.
dotnet build -c Release reports zero warnings and zero errors.

summary: Fixed inverted branch order in FfprobeRunner.ResolveBinaryPath() — library override path now evaluated first, matching FfmpegRunner's three-step chain.
Made ResolveBinaryPath() internal to allow pure-unit testing without spawning a process.
Updated XML doc comment to reflect the corrected resolution order.

Renamed ProbeAsync_UsesProvisionedPath_WhenBothPathsAreSet to ProbeAsync_UsesLibraryOverridePath_WhenBothPathsAreSet and rewrote it: library path now points to real ffprobe, provisioner path to a non-existent binary.

Added three new pure-unit [Fact] tests exercising ResolveBinaryPath() directly: ReturnsLibraryPath_WhenLibraryPathIsSet, ReturnsProvisionerPath_WhenOnlyProvisionerPathIsSet, ReturnsFallback_WhenNeitherPathIsSet.
Removed priority-inversion open item from constraints.md; replaced FfmpegRunner bullet note with unified statement that both runners share the same user-override → provisioner → PATH order.
Removed stale priority-inversion inline comment and updated resolution order description in api-surface.md.
Build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. Unit suite: 326/326 pass. Integration suite: 214/220 pass, 6 skipped (binary/DB-gated live tests — all previously skipped).

comments.note: FfprobeRunner.cs and FfmpegRunner.cs are structurally near-identical — binary name constant, constructor, ProbeAsync/ExtractFrameAsync, ResolveBinaryPath. The two runners could share a base class or a BinaryResolver helper if more runners are added, but the WP spec explicitly defers this refactor to a future tools-layer cleanup.

FfprobeRunnerTests.cs: the three new pure-unit tests live in VideoIndexer.Infrastructure.Tests (the integration suite) rather than VideoIndexer.Tests (the unit suite). Since ResolveBinaryPath() is a pure in-memory call with no DB or binary dependencies, these tests would be more appropriately placed in the unit suite. Consider moving them when the test project boundaries are next reviewed.

The SkippableFact live tests in FfprobeRunnerTests.cs (ProbeAsync_UsesLibraryOverridePath_WhenBothPathsAreSet, ProbeAsync_WhenFfprobeExitsNonZero_ThrowsInvalidOperationException_ContainingStderr, ProbeAsync_RealVideoFile_ReturnsJsonWithExpectedTopLevelFields) self-skip silently when ffprobe is absent. A one-line diagnostic reason string is already provided, which is sufficient.
